svg.text: A river mouth broken into islands: the town on stilts and bridges, tide flats between, the lighthouse on an offshore rock.

g.text: wreck camp · tide pools · fords at low tide

svg.text: Maze: islands joined by bridges and tide fords, many ways
across and few straight lines. Bridges are chokepoints, creeks
hide coves and chests, and the low tide opens new fords. Easy
to get lost, rich to explore; the lighthouse is the landmark.
the station on the north bank
Stilt Town, then over the bridges
the Gilded Parlor, a card house on stilts
from the docks, out over the bar
the stern gangway, past Hester's Rock
stern gangway onto the aft deck
down to the casino: the hub
